desc: An unincorporated village in Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, about thirty miles southeast of Pittsburgh, and the claimed site of the 9 December 1965 recovery. The contemporaneous Greensburg Tribune-Review reported that the wooded area where something was said to have come down was immediately sealed off on the order of US Army and State Police officials in anticipation of a close inspection, with Army engineers and possibly civilian scientists expected; a subsequent edition reported that searchers failed to find any object. Local residents collected by Stan Gordon over four decades describe an acorn-shaped object roughly the size of a Volkswagen Beetle bearing markings resembling hieroglyphs, removed on a flatbed truck; a prop built for the 1990 Unsolved Mysteries episode remains on display in the village. Kecksburg is the geographic anchor of the only successful FOIA litigation in this domain: the records Leslie Kean sued NASA for in 2003 were records about this location and this date, and the court found in 2007 that NASA had not adequately searched for them.
